sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.requestDescription: Sequential bounded grid cells, at most 128 requests; dense or timed-out cells subdivided at most three times. Verified source cells cached individually and merged by ID/version.

sources.name: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints
sources.attribution: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints, CDLA Permissive 2.0
sources.acquisitionNote: Per-feature imagery acquisition dates are unavailable in these tiles. Release date is not imagery date.

sources.provider: Copernicus Sentinel-2 via Element 84 Earth Search
sources.processingNotes: Provider-documented 8-bit true-colour image (TCI), RGB from Sentinel-2 B4/B3/B2; native 10 m COG windows only, no artificial upsampling, scale=1/offset=0/gamma=1 for this display-ready product. Nearest-neighbour 20 m scene classification mask retains only classes 4 (vegetation), 5 (non-vegetated land) and 6 (water), rejecting cloud, cirrus, shadow, snow, defective and unclassified pixels. This is a single acquisition, not a composite; local cloud masking is imperfect. Roof sampling separately requires large interior areas and never infers facade colours.
sources.spatialSamplingMethod: At least four valid roof-interior pixels: median RGB. Otherwise: the single native pixel containing the footprint representative point. No neighbour search or palette assignment.
sources.limitations: Mixed native pixels can include streets, vegetation and other roofs; they are not individual roof measurements. Roof colours do not describe facade colours. Shadow/cloud rejection is incomplete. Missing or invalid pixels remain unobserved.

sources.name: GEDTM30 global bare-earth terrain
sources.attribution: GEDTM30 v1.2 — Ho, Y.-F. and Hengl, T. / OpenGeoHub (2026), CC BY 4.0. Cropped, reprojected and sampled for MoroccoVoxelMap; water levels conditioned from mapped hydrography.
sources.citation: Ho et al. (2025), GEDTM30: global ensemble digital terrain model at 30 m and derived multiscale terrain variables. PeerJ 13:e19673. https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj.19673
sources.processingNotes: Current v1.2 Float32 raw values are metres according to publisher metadata dated June 10, 2026. The source still exposes a stale 0.1 raster scale tag; it is explicitly ignored for this pinned product, never applied twice. No elevation samples are synthesized during acquisition. Native window retained with scale=1; 30 m projected display interpolation does not improve source resolution. The sourceTimePeriod is the product filename reference interval, not one survey acquisition date.
sources.limitations: Modeled bare-earth terrain at approximately 30 m, not surveyed floor/entrance elevation or a building-height measurement. Residual structures, shoreline artifacts and local errors may remain.
